_comment: Seed studies, most recently re-pulled live 2026-08-09 via Playwright+cache-buster across ICON, PPD/Thermo(Trialmed), Fortrea, Celerion, Altasciences (KC/LA/MTL), Spaulding, Nucleus, Frontage, JBR/CenExel, BioPharma Services — Worldwide alone stays manual/phone-only (see below). pay_gross is 'up to' — reconfirm + get payout schedule on the screening call. stays=array of confinement nights (null=unknown, confirm). visits=in-person follow-ups (travel trips). bmi null=portal didn't publish (confirm against your own profile.bmi; typical floors run 18-18.5). currency USD unless noted. eligible=false with exclude_reason for female-only / overweight-BMI27+ / closed / ethnobridging. payout.type unknown for all until confirmed by phone — this is the #1 question to ask (see docs/SCREENING-CALL-SCRIPT.md). source_url is ALWAYS a real per-study detail page, never a network homepage/search page — network_url (paired with phone, no source_url) marks a row where no such page exists; components/ranked-table.tsx renders that as an honest 'call to apply' instead of a disguised link. RULE: no study ships without verified_by + a real per-study source_url (or the honest phone-only fallback). See docs/DATA-INTEGRITY.md. ⚠ Historical note (2026-08-08): earlier PPD/trialmed 'healthy' studies were FABRICATED by a research pass and removed. FIXED 2026-08-09 (story: fix-study-deep-links): re-checked live and confirmed trialmed.com now genuinely does list real healthy-volunteer studies with their own per-study pages (a real change on their site since the 2026-08-08 note above, independently live-DOM-verified here, not a repeat of that incident) — PPD/Thermo rows below are real, verified_by:playwright-DOM. The same story fixed a Fortrea href bug (study 783120's listing href is a genuine non-standard shape on Fortrea's own site; pull-studies.mjs now cross-verifies any such anomalous href's own page content before trusting it) and replaced Altasciences/Celerion/Frontage/Nucleus/BioPharma's prior generic-homepage-as-source_url rows with real per-study links (BioPharma wasn't one of this story's originally-named 8 networks, but its own acceptance criteria cover every study in the ranked table) — see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md's per-network recipe table. NOTE: the personal `profile` object formerly here (BMI/weight/height/conditions) has moved to gitignored .local/profile.json — see CLAUDE.md. AUTOMATED REFRESH (daily-refresh-scheduled story): all networks with a real recipe (see docs/DATA-SOURCES.md) are now re-pulled daily by scripts/pull-studies.mjs via .github/workflows/daily-study-refresh.yml — the known listing-vs-detail-page gap (special_pop nuance from a phone/detail pass may not survive an automated refresh) still applies.
